# netbox_cluster_type (Data Source)

Retrieves a single cluster type from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_cluster_type" "example" {
  name = "VMware"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the cluster type.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_count` (Number) The number of cluster of the cluster type.
- `cluster_type_id` (Number) The ID of the cluster type associated with the cluster type.
- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the cluster type.
- `created` (String) When the cluster type was created.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the cluster type, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the cluster type.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_updated` (String) When the cluster type was last changed.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the cluster type.
- `slug` (String) The slug of the cluster type.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
